content: These tables are Lakemeter reporting rollups refreshed daily from system.billing.usage.
list_cost is usage_quantity multiplied by the public list price, in the row's currency_code.

Every row is attributed to attributed_user with a confidence grade: HIGH means the billing record named the executing identity (run_as); MEDIUM means resource owner or creator; LOW means an owner custom tag; NONE means UNATTRIBUTED.
cost_center comes from the FinOps-maintained mapping table, then the cost_center tag, then UNMAPPED.
product_line is one of: sql_warehouse, model_serving, dlt_pipeline, jobs, interactive_cluster, foundation_model_api, other.

Genie and dashboard tables are query activity, not cost: their compute is billed to the SQL warehouse and appears under product_line sql_warehouse. Join on warehouse_id and usage_date to apportion warehouse spend.
Genie One and Agents usage is free through 2027-01-31; billing corrections that negate it are already included in the spend tables.
